summary: Goldman Sachs Private Credit Corp. filed an 8-K under Items 3.02, 7.01, and 8.01, reporting an unregistered sale of equity securities (Class I, S, D shares) yielding ~$84M in consideration, alongside a routine monthly distribution declaration for May 2026 and estimated NAV-based total returns. The share sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulations D/S. No special-situation catalyst or strategic event is described; the filing is an ordinary periodic update.
